caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section filled with a repeating pattern. The pattern consists of three columns and four rows of circular motifs, each outlined with small brown and yellow ovals. Inside each circle are red and pink flowers with yellow leaves. At the intersections between the circles are larger, stylized floral shapes in bright red and orange, with yellow highlights radiating outward. Along the left side of the rectangle, there are red branching elements with small leaves. The background inside the rectangle is shaded in light gray, providing contrast for the colorful motifs, while the area outside the rectangle remains uncolored, blending with the cream-colored paper.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
